resources.name: Spinel Li1.33Mn1.67O4 crystal structure (Fd-3m, a=8.19 Å)

access.notes: Publicly known structure from literature (Blasse, 1964). Atomic coordinates can be generated from space group and lattice parameter; no external download required.
Must support molecular‑cluster calculations with point‑charge embedding and Mulliken or Löwdin population analysis. PySCF can be installed via pip.
